svg.title: Aster Bank use case diagram
svg.desc: Hand-drawn-style UML sketch with four actors. The Customer registers, opens accounts, deposits, withdraws, transfers, and views statements. The Bank Teller deposits funds. The Bank Admin views transactions, reverses a transaction, runs month-end, and reviews the audit log. The external Notification Service delivers transaction and low-balance alerts. Transfer Funds includes Authenticate. Reverse Transaction extends View Transaction.
